<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan]]
**The [[Taliban]] kills 27 members of the [[Afghan National Security Forces]] in a series of coordinated attacks in northern [[Afghanistan]] after refusing to discuss peace in the region with government officials. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/01/01/world/asia/afghanistan-attacks-taliban.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[War in North-West Pakistan]]
**[[Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan]] gunmen attack a security base in the [[Loralai]] area of [[Pakistan]], resulting in the deaths of four security guards and four terrorists, including a [[Suicide attack|suicide bomber]]. Two guards were also injured in the attack. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/gunmen-attack-security-base-in-pakistan-s-balochistan-province-11078440 (Channel NewsAsia)]

;Disasters and accidents
*At least nine people are killed and 34 others are missing after a landslide strikes a village in [[Sukabumi]], [[West Java]], in [[Indonesia]]. [https://www.perthnow.com.au/news/asia/indonesian-landslide-leaves-nine-dead-in-west-java-ng-b881062909z?fbclid=IwAR3QTNzJ-Hbhh5L6gcOFS3PlIjdQKqdE2Nnd6fnjSQvNN_SMnXD9zp_XPDk (''Sunday Times'')]

;Law and crime
*[[2019 Tokyo car attack]]
**A car plows into [[New Year's Eve|New Year's]] celebrators in [[Tokyo]], [[Japan]], injuring eight. A ninth person was assaulted by the driver after he got out of the vehicle. Police believe the incident to be intentional. [https://globalnews.ca/news/4805677/tokyo-car-hits-pedestrians-new-years/ (Global News)] [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/9-hurt-as-car-rams-into-crowd-at-famed-tokyo-street-on-new-year-11077634 (Channel NewsAsia)]
* [[Bottrop and Essen car attack]]
** Five people are injured after a man intentionally drives a car into multiple crowds of people in the cities of [[Bottrop]] and [[Essen]], [[Germany]]. Police say the incident appears to be a xenophobic, far-right attack. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/germany-car-attack-far-right-crowd-injured-syrian-afgan-bottrop-a8706546.html (''The Independent'')]
*Armed men believed to be traditional hunters have killed at least 37 people in an attack on a village in central [[Mali]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-46732703 (BBC News)]
*A [[Thai people|Thai]] man kills six members of his family before killing himself in a drunken shooting spree. [https://www.rt.com/newsline/447866-thailand-new-year-rampage/ (RT)] [https://bnonews.com/index.php/2018/12/7-dead-in-shooting-at-new-years-party-in-thailand/?fbclid=IwAR2Gv96f1E857p7KL_vqDSJ3ZrBcuHNCx7Jj1JQJS52CHKRO6xvrpuLe84I (BNO News)]
*[[Same-sex marriage in Austria|Same-sex marriage]] becomes legal in [[Austria]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/austrian-women-celebrate-countrys-sex-marriage-60104054 (ABC News)]
*[[Intersex rights in Germany]]
**A law recognising a [[third gender]] that can be administered for [[intersex people]] takes effect in [[Germany]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-46727611 (BBC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Jair Bolsonaro]] is inaugurated as the 38th [[president of Brazil]], succeeding [[Michel Temer]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-46720899 (BBC News)]

*[[2018 Democratic Republic of the Congo general election]]
**U.S. and EU diplomats urge the Congolese government to restore internet connection to the country after it was shut down the previous day amid fears of election fraud. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/jan/01/drc-electoral-fears-rise-as-internet-shutdown-continues (''The Guardian'')]
*[[U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] requests a bipartisan meeting with lawmakers to discuss the wall as a [[United States federal government shutdown of 2018–2019|partial government shutdown]] enters its second week. [https://www.mprnews.org/story/2019/01/01/trump-invites-top-lawmakers-for-talks-as-shutdown-continues?fbclid=IwAR1YRs78X_IjfPg9M_ATRF9oVcF6YT3BbHk3cMCnDPXCTRsUcMDcXt-_j20 (MPR News)]
;Science and technology
*[[2019 in spaceflight]]
**''[[New Horizons]]'' makes a flyby of Kuiper belt object {{mpl|2014 MU|69}}, nicknamed Ultima Thule, at 05:33 UTC, becoming the farthest object in the [[Solar System]] visited by a spacecraft. It is a [[Contact binary (small Solar System body)|contact binary]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/12/31/science/new-horizons-ultima-thule.html (''The New York Times'')]
